subject.title: fix(plugins): keep openclaw chunks native in jiti

question: Should OpenClaw accept `nativeModules: ["openclaw"]` as the shared jiti boundary for plugin-loaded OpenClaw package chunks before landing this PR?
rationale: The dependency contract supports the option and the fix is narrow, but it deliberately changes the shared plugin-loader module graph for existing plugin execution paths.

options.title: Accept And Land After Cleanup
options.body: Remove the release-owned changelog edit, clear the current CI failure, and land the focused native-module boundary.

options.title: Request Packaged Marker Proof
options.body: Ask for a current packaged before/after marker run if source-level and Crabbox proof are not enough for this loader contract.

options.title: Pause Native Boundary
options.body: Hold the PR if any supported plugin contract intentionally depends on OpenClaw chunks being re-evaluated inside jiti.

recommendation.title: Accept And Land After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove the release-owned changelog edit, clear the current CI failure, and land the focused native-module boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal for the shared jiti helper and already reviewed this exact maintainer-sweep decision.
